text:
Jae (AE): FYI transferring FinLumen to CS. Signing completed, committed to Dedicated capacity. Key context below — please pick owners and next steps.

Jae (AE): Account health: usage is low (20% of expected qps), onboarding stalled on SSO and private registry access. Renewal in 11 months but CSM flagged adoption risk.

Priya (CSM): Thanks — assigning ownership. I'll take primary CSM. Need two things: (1) SSO checklist done, (2) a technical enablement for their infra team.

Riley (CSEng): Noted. What blockers on SSO? ADFS metadata? Can we get a test IdP?

Jae (AE): They use ADFS 2019. Sales collected metadata but customer hasn't provided cert thumbprint. Also there are blocked IPs for the private control plane; networking team needs to whitelist Redwood egress.

Marco (Support L2): I'll own support queue for infra tickets. Please open ticket with org_id and latest logs.

Priya (CSM): Action items: 1) Jae to share org + contact (done below). 2) Riley + Elena to run enablement (owner: Riley). 3) Marco to open support case (owner: Marco). 4) Follow-up sync in 3 business days.

Elena (SalesEng): FYI saw elevated embedding latency on their Dedicated test run — may be quantized model incompat. Quick mitigation: change model variant to rdx-small-1-fp16 for now.

Riley (CSEng): Helpful. Can you share the run id and sample latency numbers? I can validate kernel selection and pin a rollback plan.

Jae (AE): Run id: run_20260312_finlumen_09. 95thp token latency ~420ms on their trial pool. Pinned model currently rdx-small-1-qat.

Marco (Support L2): Opening ticket PROD-6742 with logs link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROD-6742. Attaching network capture and kube events.

OncallBot: Incident created PROD-6742 assigned to Marco (Support L2). Priority: P2.

Priya (CSM): Scheduling enablement: proposed Wed 10am PT. Riley + Elena + FinLumen infra lead. I'll send calendar invite and pre-reads (SSO checklist, Dedicated runbook, network egress IPs).

Riley (CSEng): I'll prepare a short troubleshooting playbook: steps to change model variant, validate KV cache sizes, and how to test latency after change.

Elena (SalesEng): I'll include a short demo of Dedicated autoscaling and how burst capacity works — this usually helps with adoption concerns.

Jae (AE): Customer contacts: Maya Chen (FinLumen IT) maya@finlumen.com, Sam Ortiz (Prod) sam@finlumen.com. Org ID: org_6472. Billing: yearly committed.

Priya (CSM): I'll capture feedback during enablement and open adoption playbook items. Immediate risk = medium because usage low + SSO delay. Owner matrix: CSM: Priya; CSEng: Riley; Support: Marco; SE: Elena; AE: Jae.

Marco (Support L2): Please DM me the certificate and a sanitized kube logs tarball. I'll try model variant swap in their staging cluster first.

Riley (CSEng): Understood — I'll prepare a `rdx` model switch snippet for them and a validation checklist.

Priya (CSM): Closing loop for now. I'll post a follow-up thread after the enablement with adoption next steps and renewal health update. :white_check_mark:
